q: A logic gate is an electronic device which takes information from the environment, makes a decision, and then gives out the ______.
e: A logic gate is an electronic device which takes information from the environment, makes a decision, and then gives out the result. Input or voltage is not this quantity.

q: Logic gates are commonly built using ______.
e: Logic gates are commonly built using small integrated circuits (ICs). Do not trade small integrated circuits (ICs) for vacuum tubes or mechanical relays.

q: The five common logic gates are ______.
e: The five common logic gates are AND, OR, NAND, NOR, NOT. Do not trade AND, OR, NAND, NOR, NOT for AND, OR, XOR, XNOR, BUFFER or ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD.

q: A NOT gate has ______ input(s).
e: A NOT gate has one input(s). Two or three is not this quantity.

q: For a 2-input AND gate, the output is HIGH only when ______.
e: For a 2-input AND gate, the output is HIGH only when both inputs are HIGH. Do not trade both inputs are HIGH for both inputs are LOW or either input is HIGH.

q: For a 2-input OR gate, the output is LOW only when ______.
e: For a 2-input OR gate, the output is LOW only when both inputs are LOW. Both inputs are high or either input is high is not this quantity.

q: For a 2-input NAND gate, the output is LOW only when ______.
e: For a 2-input NAND gate, the output is LOW only when both inputs are HIGH. Do not trade both inputs are HIGH for both inputs are LOW or either input is LOW.

q: For a 2-input NOR gate, the output is HIGH only when ______.
e: For a 2-input NOR gate, the output is HIGH only when both inputs are LOW. Both inputs are high or either input is high is not this quantity.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input AND gate is ______.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input AND gate is X = AB. X = A + B or X = AB is a different relation from X = AB.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input OR gate is ______.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input OR gate is X = A + B. X = AB or X = A + B is a different relation from X = A + B. X = a + b is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NAND gate is ______.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NAND gate is X = AB. X = AB or X = A + B is a different relation from X = AB.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NOR gate is ______.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NOR gate is X = A + B. X = AB or X = A + B is a different relation from X = A + B. X = a + b is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.

q: The Boolean expression for a NOT gate is ______.
e: The Boolean expression for a NOT gate is X = A. X = A or X = A + 1 is a different relation from X = A. X = a is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.

q: NAND and NOR gates are called universal gates because they ______.
a: can replace any other gate type when combined
e: NAND and NOR gates are called universal gates because they can replace any other gate type when combined. Consume less power or are faster than others is not this quantity.

q: The inverter (NOT gate) changes a LOW input to a ______ output.
e: The inverter (NOT gate) changes a LOW input to a HIGH output. Low or zero is not this quantity.

q: A basic 2-input logic circuit has a HIGH on one input and a LOW on the other, and the output is HIGH. The gate is most likely a(n) ______.
e: A basic 2-input logic circuit has a HIGH on one input and a LOW on the other, and the output is HIGH. The gate is most likely a(n) OR gate. And gate or nand gate is not this quantity.

q: A logic circuit requires HIGHs on all its inputs to make the output HIGH. This describes a(n) ______.
e: A logic circuit requires HIGHs on all its inputs to make the output HIGH. This describes a(n) AND gate. Do not trade AND gate for OR gate or NOR gate.

q: An OR gate can be constructed using ______ NAND gates.
e: An OR gate can be constructed using three NAND gates. Do not trade three for two or four.

q: A NOT gate can be constructed using ______ NAND gate(s).
e: A NOT gate can be constructed using one NAND gate(s). Two or three is not this quantity.

q: An AND gate can be constructed using ______ NAND gates.
e: An AND gate can be constructed using two NAND gates. Do not trade two for one or three.

q: A NOR gate can be constructed using ______ NAND gates.
e: A NOR gate can be constructed using four NAND gates. Three or five is not this quantity.
